answer: Each identity must burn a unique device attestation key and post a 500-token stake that the registry records as a canyon separating it from all others. Forging one costs that 500-token lock, a full 100 percent slash, and a 30-epoch wait before the stake clears. Copying identities multiplies that marginal cost per fake while independent jurors share each penalty across the whole cluster, so splitting never lowers the marble or the lantern of total expense.
